svg.title: Learning
svg.desc: Everything that can happen to a market event. The usual path runs straight down; edge cases branch to the right and rejoin it. Learning stages the event in two parts, working memory and then long-term memory; a person then checks every change to both, including the second- and third-order ripple, and only what they approve is committed. Inference reads committed versions and never writes.

svg.text: Something that happened and was published: news, a data release, a filing, or an imported item. Its publication
time decides the day it is folded in.

Anything in the graph: an entity (an actor or an idea), a subentity (one of its values), an interaction (a causal
link), or a superentity (a recurring group).
